amy_sales: Jordan at AcmeRetail requested a short POC: streaming responses that trigger a function call to return validated JSON per-tenant. Needs pricing for 90d pilot (~5M tokens/day), SAML SSO, and KMS guidance. Can we outline steps and blockers?
jordan_cust: yes please. also need an infra runbook for ephemeral tokens and reconnect behavior.
vikram_se: Quick plan: 1) Demo on Hosted to start (fast), offer Dedicated if they need SLA/iso. 2) Provide SDK sample showing websocket streaming + function_call handling + schema validation. 3) Security pack: SAML metadata, KMS BYOK option, SOC2 summary.
vikram_se: SDK pseudo (py) to share:
```python
from redwood import Client
cli = Client(api_key="<TEMP>")
with cli.stream(model="redwood-chat-1") as s:
    s.send({"input":"Fetch invoices for tenant: 77","functions":[{"name":"get_invoices","schema":{"type":"object","properties":{"tenant_id":{"type":"integer"}}}}]})
    for ev in s.recv():
        if ev.type=="function_call":
            res = get_invoices(ev.args)
            s.send({"function_response":res})
        elif ev.type=="chunk":
            print(ev.text, end='')
```
liz_prod: Emphasize structured_output flag + provide JSON schema. We run pre-flight tests to assert conformance and surface mismatches.
tom_infra: Handshake/runbook: issue ephemeral token via auth bridge, TTL 1h, rotate every 45m, reconnect flow: close -> get token -> reconnect. Use websocket for low latency. Example curl to get token and connect provided.
sec_bot: Uploaded security questionnaire answers and SOC2 summary: https://redwood.internal/sq/acme-1799990011 (sales+sec)
vikram_se: Pricing: draft two options: Hosted pilot blended rate with usage cap and Dedicated trial with monthly commit. I'll post numbers in the sales doc.
amy_sales: Jordan, can you share SAML metadata and confirm if PII must stay on-prem? That affects Dedicated vs Private.
jordan_cust: SAML metadata will be sent today. No on-prem PII for pilot.
amy_sales: Great. Proposed demo slot: Tue 10am PT, 90m. Can you confirm infra invite?
jordan_cust: Confirmed, adding infra lead.
vikram_se: Action items: share SDK sample + small test harness for schema checks, handoff ephemeral token runbook, pricing note, and security pack by EOD.
amy_sales: Thanks team — let's keep the pilot friction low and document any Private timeline if needed.
